provenance.scope: Validated aggregate outputs only; no game-level records or new inference.
provenance.intervals: Marginal 95% intervals; see the research report for assumptions.

rating_adjusted.model: IPW score mean regression: speed-band intercepts + natural cubic rating-difference spline

summary.adjustment: BH over speed, band and speed-band tests; primary excluded
summary.uncertainty: Poisson multiplier ratio bootstrap with Bernoulli finite-population correction
summary.exact_test: Unweighted decisive games only; not an exact weighted-pool test

summary.adjustment: Separate BH families for score-spread and full W/D/B-distribution omnibus tests
summary.assumptions: Independent games within each cell; representative dyadic sensitivity reported separately

robustness.note: Exploratory; each scenario has its own BH family. Unsigned spread has no direction. interpretation_stable means at least one cell rejects, not stable cell decisions or ranks.
